title: CORS that reflects any origin
note: OAuth routes use cors({ origin: true, credentials: true }) (src/routes/shopifyOAuthRoutes.js:19-21): any origin is reflected WITH credentials. Not exploitable today because every route authenticates by a bearer session token, never a cookie; still an anti-pattern. The dashboard router (origin: true, credentials: false) is by design.
